description: Kerala rebrands IT department as "Kerala Tech" to boost innovation, AI, and semiconductor missions for sustainable growth.
body_lead: With the aim of giving Kerala’s information technology sector a new identity aligned with the changing times, the State government has decided to rename the Electronics & IT department as the IT, Future Technologies and Start-ups department, under the new brand name “Kerala Tech”. The announcement was made in the Governor’s Policy Address in the Assembly on Friday. The Kerala IT Mission will also undergo a transformation and become Digital Transformation Mission by including the Kerala AI Mission and the Kerala Emerging Technologies Mission.
